# NepalCloud

> NepalCloud Host Pvt. Ltd. provides shared hosting, WordPress hosting, cloud hosting, VPS servers, RDP servers, dedicated servers, domain registration, and support for teams building or growing online in Nepal. Founded 2024, based in Kathmandu, Nepal.

## Company

- Name: NepalCloud Host Pvt. Ltd.
- Website: https://nepalcloud.com.np
- Founded: 2024
- Location: Thankot, Kathmandu, Nepal
- Phone: +977 9769683142
- Email: support@nepalcloud.host
- Payments: eSewa, Khalti, ConnectIPS, IME Pay, Bank Transfer
- Languages: English, Nepali
- Uptime SLA: 99.9%
- Money-back: 14 days

## Structured Data

- [All Plans JSON API](https://nepalcloud.com.np/plans.json): Machine-readable JSON with every plan, price (NPR), specs, and order URLs
- [Full Site Export](https://nepalcloud.com.np/llms-full.txt): Complete company and product data in one Markdown file

## Hosting Products

- [Shared Hosting](https://nepalcloud.com.np/shared-hosting): cPanel, NVMe, from Rs. 50/mo. Best for blogs, portfolios, small sites.
- [WordPress Hosting](https://nepalcloud.com.np/wordpress-hosting): cPanel + LiteSpeed cache, from Rs. 60/mo. Best for WordPress and WooCommerce.
- [DirectAdmin Hosting](https://nepalcloud.com.np/direct-admin-hosting): DirectAdmin panel, from Rs. 500/yr. Best for developers managing multiple sites.
- [Cloud Hosting](https://nepalcloud.com.np/cloud-hosting): Scalable cPanel, NVMe, from Rs. 200/mo. Best for growing businesses.
- [VPS Hosting](https://nepalcloud.com.np/vps-hosting): Linux KVM, AMD EPYC, from Rs. 899/mo. Best for apps, custom stacks, SaaS.
- [RDP Server](https://nepalcloud.com.np/rdp-hosting): Windows RDP, AMD EPYC, from Rs. 899/mo. Best for remote desktop and Windows apps.
- [Reseller Hosting](https://nepalcloud.com.np/reseller-hosting): WHM + cPanel, from Rs. 1,500/mo. Best for agencies and hosting businesses.
- [Dedicated Server](https://nepalcloud.com.np/dedicated-server): Full root, AMD/Intel, from Rs. 5,000/mo. Best for high-traffic and enterprise.
- [Free Web Hosting](https://nepalcloud.com.np/free-web-hosting): 1 month free trial with SSL and backups.
- [Free Student Hosting](https://nepalcloud.com.np/free-student-hosting): Free for Nepali students with DirectAdmin and SSL.
- [Node.js Hosting](https://nepalcloud.com.np/nodejs-hosting): Node.js optimized VPS hosting.
- [Python Hosting](https://nepalcloud.com.np/python-hosting): Python optimized VPS hosting.
- [AI Hosting](https://nepalcloud.com.np/ai-hosting): VPS for self-hosting AI tools, LLMs, agents (Ollama, n8n, Open WebUI, Dify). From Rs. 899/mo.

## Domains

- [Domain Search](https://nepalcloud.com.np/domain-search): Register .com, .np, and global domains with DNS management.
- [Domain Transfer](https://nepalcloud.com.np/domain-transfer): Transfer domains with guided support and renewal-friendly pricing.
- [Domain Promos](https://nepalcloud.com.np/domain-promos): Current domain deals and limited-time offers.
- [.np Domain Cover Letter](https://nepalcloud.com.np/np-domain-cover-letter): Generate cover letters for .np domain registration.
- [WHOIS Lookup](https://nepalcloud.com.np/whois): Check domain ownership and registrar details.
